title: Native Windows Encrypted Backup and Restore

preflight.note: Registered before implementation in a clean isolated public worktree at exact base 927a57c9119d24581e8fe3fc1f1bd68e7ab1d0af after verifying WI324-WI329 were free. The shared dirty checkout, WI323 worktree, private repository, installed application, and preserved learner backup are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Windows backup export uses a native destination picker and reports completion only after the encrypted file is durably written to the chosen destination.
Restore validates and decrypts before replacing learner data, preserves a recoverable prior copy, and reports bounded actionable failures.
Windows acceptance covers cancellation, denied or invalid destination, successful export/import roundtrip, and preservation of prior state on failure.

source: Accepted persistence/state-authority discovery; implementation explicitly deferred from WI324.
